expected_response.note: No permitted bounded edit is connected to the Analyst's leading reproducible contrast; incumbent retained with explicit fallback.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend to chase pair-kernel or moment contrasts would treat a diagnostic feature as an independent force the executing formula does not contain.
Selecting a single landmark region_index would pool opposite-signed softmin and occupancy observables at the same landmark.
Using recorded joint-head survival credit as if it were decoded terminal affinity benefit would overstate the evidence.
Interpreting joint-motion RMS or turnover-residual diagnostics as local coordinate forces or causal selection effects would misstate their semantics.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible signed contrasts are on pair-distance shell densities (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5 positive, pair_kernel_7.0 negative; endpoint_effects:9-13, branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241/167/244), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). The only operative knobs are pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend (allowed_edits). None of these is a pair-kernel or moment parameter, so no registered bounded edit can be connected to the Analyst's leading hypothesis without treating a diagnostic feature as a force the formula does not contain. The landmark softmin/occupancy signs are mixed and observable-dependent (endpoint_effects:14/15, 32/34, 68/70), so no single region_index direction is defensible. Joint-motion RMS effects are reproducible but are pose diagnostics, not local coordinate information, and are not terms in the executing scalar. Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; clocks label_semantics; lineage_support terminal metadata at score time 0.99 outside the observed window [0.0,0.5]), so it cannot justify an affinity-first edit. Turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics whose sign can oppose the edge rate (turnover:13/14, 16/17, 133/134, 223/224, 253/254, 496/497, 523/524, 583/584). Teacher-agreement diagnostics (information_audit, teacher_modes) are observational and do not establish a fitted affinity predictor, and temperatures are immutable. With no defensible expected advantage from any permitted edit, retaining the incumbent is the correct affinity-first choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a registered operative parameter whose formula contains the Analyst's leading observable, or decoded terminal affinity labels showing a reproducible benefit.
